learning_outcomes.text: Design and select the components for an ignition system.
Implement a strategy for on-board diagnostics.
Utilize sophisticated peripheral devices in a car network and embedded processor system for real time application.

syllabus_topics: Electrical Power Supply in Vehicle Electrical Systems.
Starter Motors and Circuits. Integrated Starter Generators.
Semiconductor Devices and Power Electronic Circuits.
Micro-actuators and microsensors, micromotors, accelerometers and pressure sensors.
Emissions Control Systems. Advance Diagnostic Systems.
Adaptive Operating and Prediction Strategy of the ECM.
Electrical power sources in vehicle -alternator and accumulator
assessment_rules: To get credit, students must participate in contact teaching and fulfil all laboratory tasks. If a student misses more than 20%, additional requirements will be announced by teachers. The exam is in written form (test) and then in oral form (2 questions by lot). A minimum of 60% is required to pass the test.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
